title: Course management back office (Vue 2.7)
titleZh: 冰草约课 · 课程管理后台（Vue 2.7）
summary: The Bingcao Studio course back office built with Vue 2.7 render functions, Pling directives, and the same agent-first task guide inside a fused assistant sidebar, proving the workflow does not require Vue 3.
summaryZh: 用 Vue 2.7 渲染函数实现的冰草约课课程管理后台，通过 Pling 指令和融合侧栏中的同一套 agent-first 引导完成业务流程，不需要升级到 Vue 3。

files.roleZh: Vue 2.7 入口与 Pling 初始化

guide.title: The same task contract on Vue 2.7
guide.titleZh: 同一份任务契约也能跑在 Vue 2.7 上
intro: Vue 2.7 has the Composition API but not Vue 3's template/runtime stack. This example uses a render function, the Vue 2 adapter, and the shared DOM task view.
The interesting part is what does not change: student lookup, required-field blocking, scheduling conflicts, and activity evidence remain the same.
introZh: Vue 2.7 有组合式 API，但没有 Vue 3 的模板与运行时栈。这个示例使用渲染函数、Vue 2 适配器和共享 DOM 任务视图。
真正重要的是哪些东西没有变：学员查找、必填阻断、排课冲突和操作证据都保持一致。

steps.title: Install the Vue 2 plugin
steps.body: The entry creates one runtime and registers the Vue 2.7 plugin before mounting the page.
steps.bodyZh: 入口创建一个运行时，并在挂载页面前注册 Vue 2.7 插件。

steps.title: Declare through render functions
steps.body: The render tree applies Pling's scope and record directives explicitly. The declarations describe business regions, not DOM selectors for the agent to guess.
steps.bodyZh: 渲染树显式应用 Pling 的范围与记录指令。声明描述的是业务区域，而不是让 Agent 猜 DOM 选择器。

steps.title: Reuse the DOM task view
steps.titleZh: 复用 DOM 任务视图
steps.body: Vue 2.7 mounts the same shared task view as the standalone example and passes it to the dock, so agent understanding, page validation, task progress, and failures do not need a second implementation.
steps.bodyZh: Vue 2.7 挂载的是与独立示例相同的共享任务视图，并把它交给 Dock，因此模型理解、页面校验、任务进度与失败处理都不需要第二套实现。

steps.title: Keep the shared dock
steps.body: pling.dock opens the same Activity and Debug surfaces as the other adapters.
steps.bodyZh: pling.dock 打开与其他适配器相同的最近操作与调试界面。

guide.note: Try the duplicate-name lookup and then schedule a conflicting slot. Both should fail or resume exactly as they do in Vue 3.
guide.noteZh: 先试重名查找，再安排一个冲突时段；两者的失败与恢复行为都应与 Vue 3 一致。
